info.title: LAMISPlus EMR API
info.description: LAMISPlus is an open-source electronic medical record used across Nigeria for HIV and wider primary-care programmes. A deployment is a self-hosted Spring Boot application: the core platform serves /api/... and /core/api/v1/..., and each installed plugin is mounted under /plugin/<plugin>/ (for example the EHR plugin's PatientController declares api/v1/patient and is served at /plugin/ehr/api/v1/patient). Clients sign in at POST /core/api/v1/auth/login and send the returned accessToken as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Responses come in three envelopes: `{ statusCode, message, data }`, the `{ totalRecords, pageNumber, pageSize, totalPages, records }` paging envelope, and Spring Data's `{ content, page }`. The OpenFn lamisplus adaptor (@openfn/language-lamisplus) logs in implicitly, calls GET /plugin/ehr/api/v1/patient for getPatients, and exposes generic get/post/request helpers that can reach any path on the instance. LAMISPlus publishes no machine-readable spec and no public API documentation; this document is authored from the vendor's own source and from the implementing partner's API test suite (see source.json), and covers roughly a quarter of the ~460 endpoints a v3 deployment exposes.

ApiError.description: One failure entry. LAMISPlus reports errors as an array of these (for example `[{ "code": "INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGES", ... }]`), occasionally as a single object.

code.description: Machine-readable error code, e.g. INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGES, INVALID_INPUT_FORMAT, INTERNAL_ERROR, SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.

field.description: Request field the error is about, when it is about one.

LoginRequest.description: Credentials for the LAMISPlus login endpoint.

LoginResponse.description: A successful login. `accessToken` is sent on every later request as `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.

email.description: Email of the account that signed in.

Patient.description: A patient (LAMISPlus calls the underlying record a Person). Property names and types follow the vendor's PersonResponseDto / Person entity in github.com/lamisplus/Patient-Module. The jsonb-backed properties (address, contact, contactPoint, identifier, gender, maritalStatus, education, employmentStatus, organization) are free-form JSON in the database and are not constrained here.

uuid.description: Record UUID. A plain string column — deployments do not all store a formatted UUID.

sex.description: Sex as a free-text codeset value; the column is an unconstrained string, so casing varies between deployments (e.g. Male / MALE).

IsDateOfBirthEstimated.description: Whether dateOfBirth is an estimate. Spelt with a leading capital in PersonResponseDto.

archived.description: Soft-delete flag. Modelled as an integer (0/1) on the Person entity; some responses carry a boolean.

address.description: Address(es) as free-form JSON (jsonb column; an object or an array of AddressDto).

organization.description: Organisation the record belongs to (free-form JSON).

source.description: Where the record came from (e.g. the registering module).

PatientInput.description: Body for creating or updating a patient, following the vendor's PersonDto. Nothing is marked required here: the vendor DTO carries no validation annotations.

address.description: Address(es); free-form JSON or a list of AddressDto.

PatientPage.description: A page of patients, carried under `data` of the patient register response.

totalRecords.description: Alternative total used by some builds.

PatientListResponse.description: The patient register. The adaptor's getPatients reads `data.patients`.

PatientResponse.description: A single patient wrapped in the core `{ statusCode, message, data }` envelope.

enabled.description: Whether the account may sign in.

Role.description: A role a user can be granted.

Plugin.description: A LAMISPlus plugin (module) as reported by the plugin registry.

isEnabled.description: Whether the plugin is enabled for this facility/tenant.

PluginListResponse.description: Plugin list wrapped in the core `{ message, data }` envelope.

PagedResponse.description: The `{ totalRecords, pageNumber, pageSize, totalPages, records }` paging envelope used across the core and plugin list endpoints. Record shapes are endpoint-specific and are not documented by the vendor.

ContentPage.description: The Spring Data `{ content, page }` paging envelope used by the EHR plugin's service-point and service-location endpoints.

page.description: Spring Data page metadata (size, number, totalElements, totalPages).

ServicePoint.description: A service point patients are routed to (for example IMMUNIZATION or FAMILY_PLANNING).

servicePointName.description: Alternative name property returned by some builds.

totalNumberOfpatients.description: Spelt this way by the API.

DischargeInput.description: Body for discharging an admitted patient.
